chunks: As for voluntary fasting while traveling
Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: “Fasting while traveling is not an act of righteousness.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq, peace be upon him

ai.seo_question: Is voluntary fasting while traveling considered righteous in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that fasting during travel is not considered an act of righteousness. It indicates a legal and devotional ruling concerning the inappropriateness of voluntary fasting in the state of سفر.
